select p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, p.category, p.brand,
       p.department, p.distribution_center_id, d.name as distribution_center,
       cast(p.cost as decimal(18,4)) as current_catalog_cost,
       cast(p.retail_price as decimal(18,4)) as current_retail_price
from "thelook"."raw"."products" p
left join "thelook"."raw"."distribution_centers" d
on p.distribution_center_id = d.id

-- Public synthetic identities remain in raw; Agent-facing dimension omits direct identifiers.
select id as user_id, country, state, city, gender, traffic_source,
       case when age < 18 then 'under_18' when age < 25 then '18_24'
            when age < 35 then '25_34' when age < 45 then '35_44'
            when age < 55 then '45_54' else '55_plus' end as age_band,
       created_at as registered_at
from "thelook"."raw"."users"

select product_id
from "thelook"."commerce"."dim_products"
where product_id is null

select
    product_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "thelook"."commerce"."dim_products"
where product_id is not null
group by product_id
having count(*) > 1

select user_id
from "thelook"."commerce"."dim_users"
where user_id is null

select 'item_order' as failure, i.id as row_id
from "thelook"."raw"."order_items" i
left join "thelook"."raw"."orders" o on i.order_id = o.order_id
where o.order_id is null or i.user_id != o.user_id
union all
select 'item_product', i.id from "thelook"."raw"."order_items" i
left join "thelook"."commerce"."dim_products" p on i.product_id = p.product_id where p.product_id is null
union all
select 'item_inventory', i.id from "thelook"."raw"."order_items" i
left join "thelook"."raw"."inventory_items" v on i.inventory_item_id = v.id
where v.id is null or i.product_id != v.product_id
union all
select 'order_user', o.order_id from "thelook"."raw"."orders" o
left join "thelook"."commerce"."dim_users" u on o.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id is null

select
    user_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "thelook"."commerce"."dim_users"
where user_id is not null
group by user_id
having count(*) > 1

-- One row per order_item_id. All joins here target unique keys, never events/session rows.
select i.id as order_item_id, i.order_id, i.user_id, i.product_id, i.inventory_item_id,
       i.status as item_status, o.status as order_status,
       o.created_at as order_created_at,
       cast(timezone('UTC', o.created_at) as date) as order_date,
       i.created_at as item_created_at, i.shipped_at, i.delivered_at, i.returned_at,
       cast(i.sale_price as decimal(18,4)) as booked_item_amount,
       cast(v.cost as decimal(18,4)) as inventory_item_cost,
       case when i.status = 'Complete' then 1 else 0 end as complete_item,
       case when i.status = 'Returned' then 1 else 0 end as returned_item,
       case when i.status = 'Cancelled' then 1 else 0 end as cancelled_item,
       u.country, u.gender, u.age_band, u.traffic_source,
       p.category, p.brand, p.department, p.distribution_center_id
from "thelook"."raw"."order_items" i
join "thelook"."raw"."orders" o on i.order_id = o.order_id
left join "thelook"."raw"."inventory_items" v on i.inventory_item_id = v.id
left join "thelook"."commerce"."dim_users" u on i.user_id = u.user_id
left join "thelook"."commerce"."dim_products" p on i.product_id = p.product_id

select order_item_id
from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_order_items"
where order_item_id is null

select
    order_item_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_order_items"
where order_item_id is not null
group by order_item_id
having count(*) > 1

select order_date, country, traffic_source, category, department,
       count(*) as item_count, sum(booked_item_amount) as booked_item_amount,
       sum(complete_item) as complete_item_count, sum(returned_item) as returned_item_count,
       sum(case when complete_item = 1 then booked_item_amount else 0 end) as complete_item_amount
from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_order_items"
group by order_date, country, traffic_source, category, department

-- Aggregate item branches first, then attach to order grain to prevent fanout.
with item_totals as (
  select order_id, count(*) as item_count, sum(booked_item_amount) as booked_order_amount,
         sum(case when complete_item = 1 then booked_item_amount else 0 end) as complete_item_amount,
         sum(case when returned_item = 1 then booked_item_amount else 0 end) as returned_item_amount,
         sum(inventory_item_cost) as inventory_cost
  from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_order_items" group by order_id
)
select o.order_id, o.user_id, o.status as order_status, o.created_at,
       cast(timezone('UTC', o.created_at) as date) as order_date,
       o.shipped_at, o.delivered_at, o.returned_at, o.num_of_item as declared_item_count,
       coalesce(i.item_count, 0) as item_count, i.booked_order_amount,
       i.complete_item_amount, i.returned_item_amount, i.inventory_cost,
       u.country, u.gender, u.age_band, u.traffic_source
from "thelook"."raw"."orders" o
left join item_totals i on o.order_id = i.order_id
left join "thelook"."commerce"."dim_users" u on o.user_id = u.user_id

select order_id
from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_orders"
where order_id is null

-- Independent raw total checks, including losses from missing dimension/parent joins.
select 'item_count' as failure
where (select count(*) from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_order_items") != (select count(*) from "thelook"."raw"."order_items")
union all
select 'order_count' where (select count(*) from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_orders") != (select count(*) from "thelook"."raw"."orders")
union all
select 'booked_amount' where
  (select sum(booked_item_amount) from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_order_items") !=
  (select sum(cast(sale_price as decimal(18,4))) from "thelook"."raw"."order_items")
union all
select 'order_vs_item_amount' where
  (select sum(booked_order_amount) from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_orders") !=
  (select sum(booked_item_amount) from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_order_items")
union all
select 'dws_amount' where (select sum(booked_item_amount) from "thelook"."commerce"."dws_daily_sales") !=
  (select sum(booked_item_amount) from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_order_items")

select order_id as row_id, 'declared_item_count' as failure from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_orders"
where declared_item_count != item_count
union all
select order_item_id, 'item_status' from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_order_items"
where item_status is null or item_status not in ('Complete', 'Returned', 'Cancelled', 'Processing', 'Shipped')

select
    order_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "thelook"."commerce"."fct_orders"
where order_id is not null
group by order_id
having count(*) > 1
